ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white/tan) vs 55% low-intensity (black/dark brown) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central contiguous low-intensity region extending from the peduncle; high-intensity regions are located distally with dense, non-uniform low-intensity mottling (focal spots) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, irregular serration with varying pixel-amplitude along the entire trailing edge; notable jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the outer edges of both lobes tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured pixel clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular white spots visible within the low-intensity central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-vertical and diagonal linear streaks on the left lobe; several shorter horizontal linear disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct linear rake marks on the inner left lobe and extensive barnacle colonization clusters at both fluke terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellow-tan chromatic shift in high-intensity pixel regions contrasted against the white water-foam background.
